roundup.text:
Can AI run a business for 90 days without losing the plot?

SN15 ORO’s new SMB Bench puts agents at a simulated produce-buying desk. Eight of nine tested models finish below a simple fixed buying rule on average. ORO published the run traces, and I reproduced the headline averages from its scored data.

Also in today’s Bittensor report:
• SN107 Minos opens its Mac beta, with rewards still off.
• SN23 Trishool names SN92 REAX as its EU Mode model supplier.
• SN46 Instant’s two finalized burns total 1,199.028674159 alpha.

The November 7 edition and my latest public video are on my site.

Current public Umi README distinguishes admission, scoring and active rewards. Fresh digest operational claims lack accessible original confirmation; price decline alone cannot establish their cause or project failure.
Current Weir GPU marketplace follows registration reuse; its seven-day return crosses the old registration and is not a like-for-like product gain or verified rental revenue.
Current Fugal router documentation and November4 native commit reviewed in monitor; no fresh completed catalyst verified. Small liquidity can magnify moves; community V2 timing is not activation.
Unnamed replacement registration already verified in prior edition. Seven-day returns cross the Thirty Spokes reset; they are not a continuous successor-project return or sale price.
